sample_unit: consecutive ICU patients' arterial blood gas interpretations

links.outcome: Overall categorical accuracy and agreement of ChatGPT versus ICU physicians against expert reference diagnosis
links.effect: Accuracy 82% ICU physicians vs 72% ChatGPT; kappa 0.73 vs 0.63; paired difference not significant (p = 0.267), power 0.22.
links.quote: Paired comparison did not demonstrate a statistically significant difference in overall classification (p = 0.267), and post-hoc power analysis indicated limited ability to detect modest effect sizes (power = 0.22).

links.outcome: False reassurance: mixed acid-base disorders misclassified as normal by ChatGPT
links.effect: ChatGPT classified 16.7% of mixed cases as normal; ICU physicians produced no false-normal classifications.
links.quote: ChatGPT uniquely classified 16.7% of mixed cases as normal (false reassurance), whereas ICU physicians produced no false-normal classifications.

links.outcome: Sensitivity for mixed acid-base disorders and respiratory component detection
links.effect: Mixed-disorder sensitivity 0.96 for ICU physicians vs 0.63 for ChatGPT; respiratory component sensitivity 0.88 vs 1.00.
links.quote: Sensitivity for mixed acid–base disorders was 0.96 for ICU physicians and 0.63 for ChatGPT.

links.outcome: Harm-weighted severity of misclassification errors, ChatGPT vs physicians
links.effect: Significantly higher clinical severity of errors for ChatGPT (mean difference 0.12; 95% CI 0.032–0.220; p = 0.026), despite comparable aggregate accuracy.
links.quote: Harm-weighted misclassification modeling showed significantly higher clinical severity of errors for ChatGPT (mean difference 0.12; 95% CI 0.032–0.220; p = 0.026).

unlisted_practices: Harm-weighted misclassification modeling and complexity-stratified evaluation of AI diagnostic errors beyond aggregate accuracy

screen.reason: The study empirically assesses the performance, error structure, and clinical harm potential of ChatGPT vs ICU physicians on acid-base interpretation from ICU patient ABG data, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard intervention.
